component.name: Proto Clean
component.summary: Independent clean-room VPN client for Proton accounts

description.p: Proto Clean is an independent (clean-room) desktop client for Proton VPN accounts: backend-browser login with saved credentials and TOTP auto-fill, a free-server list with live loads, fastest-server auto-connect, WireGuard and OpenVPN tunnels, local blocklist ad-blocking, split tunneling, NAT-PMP port forwarding, IPv6 leak protection and an Xray proxy (VLESS REALITY with SNI masking and Trojan).
Not affiliated with or endorsed by Proton AG.
Link bonding (Speedify-style multi-adapter streams, net-merge-style balancing), bundled lantern-box samizdat engine (GPL-3 relicensing).
Xray proxy support (VLESS REALITY / Trojan), wider platform matrix (Windows 7+, macOS 10.15+, Android 8.0+), Flatpak.
